arabic text: KEHTE THE SHAHE ZAMAN MALIKE KAUNAIN\nHUSAINU MINI WA ANA MINAL HUSAIN
english translation text: HUSSAIN IS FROM ME AND I AM FROM HUSSAIN\nTHE HOLY PROPHET USED TO SAY THIS

arabic text: MAULA NE SAR KATADIYA ISLAM KE LIYE\nGHURBAT ME GHAR LUTAADIYA ISLAM KE LIYE
english translation text: OUR MASTER GAVE HIS HEAD TO SAVE ISLAM\nIN A FAR AWAY LAND HE HAD HIS HOLY FAMILY LOOTED TO SAVE ISLAM

arabic text: APNA LAHU BAHA DIYA ISLAM KE LIYE\nGHARBAAR SAB LUTA DIYA ISLAM KE LIYE
english translation text: HE SHED HIS BLOOD TO SAVE ISLAM\nHE GAVE EVERYTHING HE HAD TO SAVE ISLAM

arabic text: ASGAR KA KHU(N) BAHA DIYA ISLAM KE LIYE\nTUMNE GALA KATA DIYA ISLAM KE LIYE
english translation text: HE SACRIFICED HIS BABY ASGHER TO SAVE ISLAM\nHE WAS BEHEADED TO SAVE ISLAM
